tweets.text:
ICE deported a Jamaican fugitive and alleged child rapist late last month after arresting him in Stamford, CT, earlier this year. 

Albert George Davis entered the U.S. lawfully on a temporary, nonimmigrant visa June 14, 2020.  

Jamaican authorities issued a warrant for his arrest July 1, 2020, alleging he’d raped a child.  

The U.S. State Department subsequently revoked Davis’s visa, and he’d been living in New England as an illegal alien fugitive until we took him into custody. 

➡️Learn more in our Newsroom.

tweets.text:
Serial border crosser Marvin Wilton Max Ayala, a Honduran national, will serve a 27-month sentence for illegal reentry after deportation. 

He was removed four times between 2012 and 2021. Law enforcement found him in the United States on April 1, 2025, during an arrest for cocaine possession. 

He pleaded guilty to illegal reentry following an ICE investigation. He’ll be deported as soon as he completes his sentence. 

➡️Related court documents can be found on PACER under case number 25-cr-20192.
